The rear of the airship lacks the rigid, defined structure of real tail fins. It appears slightly melted or soft, failing to maintain the crisp geometric edges expected of a rigid airship frame.

The human figures on the ground have slightly irregular proportions and blurry boundaries. The tether lines connecting the airship to the ground are faint and lack clear physical attachment points, appearing somewhat ghostly.
